propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso on binding_store_mod but not binding_lifecycle module; RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and sibling operations to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.
The test passes unmutated and correctly enforces the no-churn contract, but its blast radius narrowed: it would no longer catch a regression that made clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally.

clear_absent is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass because both call sites are gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys, so no seeded unconditional-stamp mutation can drive the integration test RED.

The no-churn contract for clear_absent is independently pinned at unit tier by test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, so the integration-tier coverage gap is contained and defended.
